stories.title: Delhi Police registers FIR against organisers for holding 2,000-person running event at JLN Stadium despite denial of permission
stories.summary: Delhi Police registered an FIR against the organisers of a running event at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium. The event took place on October 11 despite denial of permission by the police. Authorities had imposed restrictions due to security concerns and protests anticipated in the city.
